description: Drive any arm-mounted camera through a scan, upload posed images as a Viam sequence dataset, and build a metric Gaussian splat with 3DGRUT

models.short_description: Scans a region with an arm-mounted camera: one sharp posed image per viewpoint, uploaded as a sequence.
Per-frame record (camera pose, joints, viewpoint) of the running scan, so the sequence has a tabular resource.
